name: Estimate it
description: Guess a quantity with a slider. Linear for everyday ranges, logarithmic for Fermi questions spanning orders of magnitude. Full credit close to the answer, partial credit further out.

fields.name: step
fields.description: Linear only: slider step. Default: about a thousandth of the range.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.description: Full-credit band. Linear: fraction of the range (default 0.04). Log: orders of magnitude (default 0.1).
